Your people.
Your phone.

Use VOIDLINE in your phone’s browser, or add it to your Home Screen. Each friend creates their own username and password. No ChatGPT account is needed.

Create an account or log in

You’re already using VOIDLINE as an app.

Android

  1. Open the app link in Chrome.
  2. Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
  3. Open VOIDLINE from the new icon and log in.

iPhone & iPad

  1. Open the app link in Safari.
  2. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
  3. If shown, leave Open as Web App on, then tap Add.
  4. Open the new VOIDLINE icon and log in.

Start talking

  1. Choose Create account and pick a username and password. Save the recovery code shown after signup.
  2. Open You, then Friends & requests. Enter their username under Add a friend, then tap Send request.
  3. After they accept, choose Message. Communities can be joined with an invitation link.

An internet connection is required. Sign in separately on each device. If you opened this page inside another app, open the link in Safari or Chrome to see installation options. Messaging works in a normal browser tab too.
